title: Data and coherence equation of a tensor scalar tower
statement: For categories C, D and E, a TensorTowerDatum consists of their category structures, binary functors U on C, V on D and B on E, scalar functors F:C→D, G:D→E and H:C→E, an isomorphism a:F⋙G≅H and normalized tensor comparisons p:U⋙F≅(F×F)⋙V, q:V⋙G≅(G×G)⋙B and r:U⋙H≅(H×H)⋙B. Its Coherent predicate is the actual component equality G(p(X,Y));q(FX,FY);B(a(X),a(Y)) = a(U(X,Y));r(X,Y) for every X,Y in C. The record contains no proof of this equation and adds no assumption. Holding the category data in a record permits transport by equality of presentations before exposing morphism compositions.

source.place: scalarOperationsOrdinary_tower, tensor clause; the same component equation after completion and rationalization

proof.text: Form the record from the stated category structures, functors and natural isomorphisms. Define Coherent to be exactly the displayed component equation, with the three category structures taken from that record. All fields are data; the equation is a proposition and is never a field chosen from an existence theorem. No proof is required to construct the record.
